associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: An auxiliary natural-number matrix associated with a family of modules.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The diagonal entry of the auxiliary matrix is positive for a finite nontrivial module.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: An auxiliary hypothesis yields positivity of the corresponding diagonal matrix entry.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Every entry of the auxiliary matrix is nonnegative.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The diagonal entry remains positive after the auxiliary matrix is mapped by natural-number casting.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Every entry remains nonnegative after the auxiliary matrix is mapped by natural-number casting.
